articles.title: China stages massive, unannounced military drills around Taiwan in 'silent intimidation'
articles.summary: China conducted a large, unannounced military exercise across the western Pacific and around Taiwan in early November. Taipei officials described this as a "silent invasion" campaign, highlighting China's assertive military posture and strategy to pressure the island. This significant drill underscores escalating regional tensions and raises concerns about stability in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: David Ellison Wants Robert Pattinson’s Batman to Join the DCU Justice League, But There’s a Catch
articles.summary: Amidst a significant regime change in the DC Universe (DCU), David Ellison reportedly seeks to retain Robert Pattinson for future projects. A new leadership is planning major changes for the DCU, following the removal of James Gunn from a prior position. This signals an overhaul in creative direction, impacting key actors and the franchise's future, potentially reshaping its global presence.

articles.title: Emmylou Harris, Sheryl Crow, Elvis Costello, More Celebrate Gram Parsons at the Troubadour
articles.summary: Psych-country pioneer Gram Parsons has finally been inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, a long-awaited recognition for the influential cult hero. His lasting impact on music, characterized by his unique sound blending country, folk, and rock, is now formally acknowledged. This induction highlights his significant contributions and enduring inspiration for artists across various genres, decades after his initial groundbreaking work.

articles.title: HC disposes of petitions against MK Yadava’s tenure in forest dept
articles.summary: Disgraced comedian Russell Brand has transitioned his online presence to Elon Musk's X (formerly Twitter) after being banned from Mark Zuckerberg's Meta platforms. This development highlights ongoing debates surrounding social media content moderation policies and platform governance. It exemplifies how public figures navigate digital spaces following disciplinary actions by major tech companies, choosing alternative platforms for engagement.

articles.title: Dharwad hosts state Masters athletics meet
articles.summary: The Philippines is set to significantly boost its defence capabilities by acquiring additional BrahMos cruise missiles and Akash air defence systems from India. This procurement not only strengthens India's position as a prominent defence exporter but also deepens bilateral strategic ties. The deal highlights India's growing indigenous defence manufacturing prowess and its role in regional security, crucial for SSB aspirants to note.
